blurb: Built on top of Tenochtitlan, the Aztec capital in a lake.

facts.t: The great double temple of Tenochtitlan was found again in 1978, when electricity workers dug up a carved stone of the moon goddess Coyolxauhqui beside the cathedral.

src.n: UNESCO: Historic Centre of Mexico City

facts.t: Diego Rivera painted the history of Mexico across the staircase of the National Palace from 1929 to 1935, from the Aztecs to the revolution.
